subject: organic
question: 有机化学·Reaction Learn 命名反应学习卡：请用文字概述该反应的主要转化：Shi epoxidation。 来源卡片给出的代表性条件：Shi catalyst (from D-fructose, 30 mol%), Oxone, K₂CO₃ (pH 10.5), MeCN/DMM, 0 °C。
answer: A fructose-derived ketone and Oxone form a chiral dioxirane in situ, which epoxidises trans- and trisubstituted alkenes enantioselectively.
explanation: 来源补充说明（未专家审核）：Basic pH (about 10.5) speeds up dioxirane formation and suppresses the Baeyer–Villiger breakdown of the ketone, so 20–30 mol% is enough. The D-fructose catalyst gives (R,R)-epoxides from trans-alkenes.
